title: Gateshead Rosh Yeshiva Rebuke
body: Rav Avrohom Gurwicz, a senior rosh yeshiva, issued a sharply worded letter opposing Chabad farbrengens, sparking discussion in the yeshiva world.

title: Yeshiva Draft Law Hits Snag
body: Knesset legal advisors oppose key clause in IDF draft bill, complicating efforts to advance Israel's long-delayed law regulating yeshiva students. MK Boaz Bismuth's committee to convene this week.

title: Supreme Court Ends Airport Jurisdiction
body: Israel's Supreme Court ruled botei din can't impose jurisdiction on Israeli citizens whose center of life is abroad, even if they briefly enter the country, ending years of legal and halachic friction over "airport jurisdiction".
